review_evidence: README identifies lean2sexp as a utility that converts compiled Lean `.olean` files to S-expressions for downstream processing.
Complete scan of its three primary Lean files found 17 declaration-style implementation items and zero theorem, lemma, axiom or proposition-example declarations.
The modules serialize Lean environment/compiled data; they do not present an independent formal semantics or proof corpus.

source_action.content_invariant: The three primary files are `.olean`/environment serialization utility code with zero proposition/proof declarations and no independently proved serialization semantics; retirement removes no mathematical or formal-specification corpus.
